lifestyle.text: I'm switching to a plant-based diet. I'll exercise every day. I'm giving up alcohol.

everyday.text: I'll spend less time on my phone and more time with my family. At the weekend we'll go hiking in the forest. I'm starting to compost, and I'll throw away less food.

rural.title: Country life (long)
rural.text: I'm leaving Budapest and moving to a small town in the countryside, because I'm tired of the noise and the expensive housing. I'm keeping my job, and I'll go on working remotely. I'll regularly invest the money I save on housing. Every week I'll volunteer in the local community. I won't buy a car; I'll get around town by bike instead.
